passages.quote: [F.A.M-E.D.] is a co-op exploration, dungeon and deck-building game for 1 to 4 players. This report shows the [agent crew] I built for it: the studio roles, how the agents pass work to each other, the game data they make, the checks they run and a playable [dungeon combat] prototype. It connects nine test builds and my final [gameplay feedback] to create an optimized studio crew idea for the production workflow I plan to use.
The agent instructions, the checks and the [runner] script for a six-card test. I can share better details as needed.
[crew-diagram.mmd], also drawn in the [README]. This report also shows my hand sketch, the [Test Crew 8] chart and my studio crew chart.
Names the game, the output, the crew roles and the folder map, and says what the files can show.

A playable dungeon combat prototype from [Test Crew 8], with its card and rule data. I can show it on request. I have not imported it into [Unreal Engine] yet, but tested in Web games and [Godot] successfully.

For this report I ran nine [test crews]. Each one used its own workflow [chart] and built the same [Combat] demo (competing with one another for a grade). Each [crew] is numbered in build order, and the Legend names its [chart]. [Test Crew 8] was the winner and its [chart] puts a [format check] before every [other check].
